title: Execution-Plan Schema — validates a GENERATED execution plan, not the proposal manifest
description: This schema validates the output of `migrate.py gen-exec-plan` (an execution-plan.json containing ONLY entries with destination_status=='approved', extracted from the full proposal manifest). It does NOT validate the full research-migration-manifest.json, which legitimately contains recommended/tentative entries that are not execution-ready by design -- use research-migration-schema.json for that. Every entry in a document validated against THIS schema is asserted, by construction (migrate.py's generate_execution_plan), to be approved and execution-ready. Cross-entry checks this schema cannot express (duplicate case-insensitive destinations, tree-policy exceptions) are enforced separately by migrate.py's validate_execution_plan().

generated_from.description: manifest_id of the source proposal manifest

destination_status.description: Every entry in an execution plan MUST be approved -- this is the whole point of the plan/manifest split.

destination_exception_approved.description: Required true if proposed_destination falls under a RESTRICTED_DESTINATION_TREE (currently docs/reports/).
